title: Personalized prediction of the following-day migraine attacks: a machine learning approach based on digital headache diary records
summary: A personalized model forecasts next-day migraine attacks from digital headache diaries.
ai_technology: Prospective three-month study at two centers analyzes 25 migraine patients; KNN reaches 91% recall and AUC 0.83 with patient-reported features.

evidence.tested: A personalized model forecasts next-day migraine attacks from digital headache diaries.
evidence.unknown: A personalized model forecasts next-day migraine attacks from digital headache diaries. Very small cohort and self-reported data mean this is an early feasibility result.
evidence.ai_role: Prospective three-month study at two centers analyzes 25 migraine patients; KNN reaches 91% recall and AUC 0.83 with patient-reported features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
